activity_summary: At night you kept the word mending and did not better it. You had the pan, the ladle, and the well, and you had not sent a day for coming. The groats were on the road.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the word once, and stopped.

entities.name: the Candlemas letter
entities.context: Mentioned in Mending, and no day

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Mending. I will not improve the word because I want a better house.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not send them the day, because I have not got the day.
